exposure: Prior cesarean delivery for arrest of descent
prior cesarean delivery for arrest of descent
Prior vaginal delivery >24 weeks vs. no prior vaginal delivery >24 weeks
cohort: 208 patients with one prior CD for arrest of descent
finding: VBAC success rates were high (84%) for women with a prior CD for arrest of descent, suggesting that arrest of descent is mostly dependent on factors unique to each pregnancy.
mod_finding: This study found that women with a prior cesarean delivery for arrest of descent had high vaginal birth after cesarean success rates.
